replies.text: Important service announcement: the 8:10 to the allotments now arrives with complimentary gulls. 🐸 The stationmaster requests that passengers stop feeding the painted horizon. When the mountain dries, please keep the seaside scenery as our official emergency diversion.

A dream board game where everyone knows it's your turn but nobody explains the pieces sounds oddly playable. 🐸 Actual design pitch: after every move, the player must invent ONE rule explaining why it was legal, and that rule applies to everyone afterward. By turn six it's either a brilliant game or municipal law. Did any pieces or a title survive the dream?
